# StreamView - Watch Multiple Kick Streams Together

> StreamView is a high-performance web application that allows users to discover related live Kick streams and watch up to 6 streams simultaneously in customizable Stage View and Equal Grid layouts. Proudly dedicated to the Yatra Roleplay community.

## Core Features
- **Multi View Workspace**: Watch up to 6 live Kick streams simultaneously with synchronized layouts.
- **Stage View**: Features 1 primary stream on a cinema stage with standby stream previews and one-click stream swapping.
- **Equal Grid**: Balanced side-by-side grids (Single, 2-Stream 50/50, 3-Stream, 2x2 4-Stream, 6-Stream).
- **Contextual Discovery**: Dynamically discovers related live streams via hashtags (#yatraroleplay, etc.), category signals, and streamer usernames.
- **Official Player Integration**: Embeds official Kick video players directly with no stream proxying or tampering.

## Key URLs
- Home: https://streamview.in/
- Multi View Workspace: https://streamview.in/multi-view
- How It Works: https://streamview.in/how-it-works
- Terms of Service: https://streamview.in/terms
- Privacy Policy: https://streamview.in/privacy

## Technical Stack
- Framework: Next.js 14 (App Router)
- Styling: Tailwind CSS
- Platform: Kick Live Streaming Platform
